purpose: Require the frozen persistent-summer-exposure metric to recover the externally known positive terrestrial-opportunity direction at Beaufort Island before computing the metric across the full eligible Antarctic site roster.

positive_control.reason: Published deglaciation at Beaufort Island increased terrestrial nesting opportunity; demographic response is not used to tune or score this measurement.

measurement.input_scenes: Use exactly the early and late Landsat item_ids already selected by the frozen full pixel-QA workflow.
measurement.grid: EPSG:3031, 30 m fixed local grid, circular 2 km radius.
measurement.spatial_support: Current frozen Antarctic Ecosystem Inventory ice-free-support mask projected by nearest neighbour; only cells with >=2 valid observations in both epochs enter the paired denominator.

decision.pass: Primary late-minus-early persistent-exposed fraction is strictly positive and all required scenes/grids are processed without technical error.
decision.fail: Zero/negative primary change or technical inability to compute the frozen metric.
decision.if_pass: Authorize full-roster outcome-blind A_available measurement using the identical code and thresholds.
decision.if_fail: Do not inspect demographic magnitudes and do not tune the exposure threshold. Stop this primary QA_PIXEL-only A_available route or freeze a separately justified measurement replacement using external evidence only.

prohibited: changing scene selection after viewing Beaufort direction
changing the 0.50 primary threshold after viewing Beaufort direction
using MAPPPD count magnitude or trend
counting Beaufort demographic response as a mina outcome
